title: Almonium overview
description: Backend, logs, host, containers, RabbitMQ and outside-in uptime. Source: almonium-infra/grafana/dashboards.

panels.title: Backend slots up
panels.description: Blue/green slots answering the metrics scrape. 2 during a deploy, 1 otherwise.

panels.title: Outside-in uptime (1h)
panels.description: Synthetic HTTP checks from Frankfurt/London against the public URLs.

panels.title: Errors logged (1h)
panels.description: logback ERROR lines in the backend.

panels.title: Latency (approx. p50 / p95 / p99)
panels.description: Estimated from five fixed buckets (0.1/0.3/1/3/10 s), so values snap toward those edges.

panels.title: Share of requests slower than 1 s

targets.expr: topk(15, sum by (method, uri) (increase(http_server_requests_seconds_sum{env="$env", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[1h])) / sum by (method, uri) (increase(http_server_requests_seconds_count{env="$env", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[1h])) > 0)
round(sum by (method, uri, status) (increase(http_server_requests_seconds_count{env="$env", status=~"[45]..", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[24h]))) > 0

panels.title: Error lines / 5 min by app (all Almonium services)
panels.description: From Loki, so it also covers the Books processor and worker.

panels.title: Hikari connections
panels.description: Waiting above zero means requests queue for a database connection.

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Drops to zero on every deploy or restart.

panels.title: Pressure (time stalled)
panels.description: Share of time some task waited on the resource. Sustained >10% means the host is the bottleneck.

panels.title: Started in the last 24 h
panels.description: Deploys and restarts. Repeated starts mean a crash loop.

panels.title: Messages waiting per queue
panels.description: Only queues with something in them are drawn.

panels.title: Messages being processed (unacked)
panels.description: Book jobs hold one delivery for hours, so a steady 1 on the Books queue is normal.

panels.title: Dead-letter queues holding messages
panels.description: A message here failed all its retries. Empty is good.

panels.title: Queues without a consumer
panels.description: Messages published here wait until something listens. Empty is good.

panels.title: TLS certificate days left
panels.description: Traefik renews automatically around 30 days before expiry.
